name: EchoLocate
tagline: A digital-forensics game where players direct AI investigator agents to contain cyberattacks in a lunar city.
problem: Digital forensics is hard to learn and rarely fun.
solution: A pixel-art strategy game in which sectors suffer attacks and players deploy specialist agents that investigate and report.
demo_moment: Team-described: dispatch an agent to a compromised datacentre.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Moonshot Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
Turns an expert field into a game.

lessons: Agents make good game characters with real jobs.
